guide_line: Use 22.4 L per mole at STP.
steps: STP here is 0 °C and 1 atm. One mole of ideal gas is 22.4 L.
Use 22.4 only at STP. Anywhere else, use PV = nRT.
Gas stoichiometry still uses the mole ratio from the equation.
H2 is 2.016 g/mol, O2 is 32.00, CO2 is 44.01, CaCO3 is 100.09, KClO3 is 122.55.
